title: In Nepal, Fears of a Second Flood Grow as Rescue Efforts Continue
summary: Nepali and Chinese authorities warned that a lake created by a deadly landslide could burst open soon. Another deluge would pose the most risk to rescuers, an expert said.

title: Palestine Action Activists Accused of Vandalism at Trump Turnberry Face Terrorism Accusation
summary: Prosecutors will seek to prove that members of Palestine Action who they say painted “Gaza is not 4 sale” on the Scottish golf course last year committed acts connected to terrorism.

title: What Our Reporter Saw After the Floods in Nepal
summary: Our correspondent Anupreeta Das witnessed the rescue operation following the catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet, in which a torrent of debris and water carried away entire villages in just minutes.

title: A Venezuelan Colonel Turned Actor Is Deported From Florida
summary: A former lieutenant colonel in Venezuela’s National Guard living in Florida was deported, interrupting a lawsuit that accused him of ordering violent raids and torture.

title: Fire Outside Home of Canadian Parliament Member Is Under Investigation
summary: Two cars were destroyed at the Toronto home of Salma Zahid, a Liberal member of Parliament, in an overnight episode condemned by Prime Minister Mark Carney.

title: Survivors of Nepal Flood Left in Stunned Disbelief: ‘They All Died, and I Lived’
summary: A visit near the border with Tibet laid bare the effects of a swollen river’s furious speed. Miles of devastation were left behind in a flash flood that killed more than 300.

title: Rafael Manuel’s Film ‘Filipiñana’ Makes a Golf Course a Villain
summary: The movie “Filipiñana” pits a country club’s members against its staff, using a golf course to explore the Philippines’ deep divides over land and class.

title: High School Sports in the Heat
summary: High temperatures and new safety rules are transforming practice as a new school year begins.

title: It’s Bake Time
summary: Our colleagues from NYT Cooking share a recipe reviewed by nearly 22,000 readers. And it still has five stars.

title: Benjamin Rosen, Who Brought Venture Capital to Tech, Dies at 93
summary: An advocate for Apple on Wall Street, he was also a founding investor in early personal computing firms like Lotus and Compaq, where he served as chairman.
